description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'SessionModelUtils' for saving, loading, and clearing the state of the 'InitializationWizardModel' object in an HTTP session. It provides methods to persist non-sensitive model fields in a web application's user session context.

classes.name: SessionModelUtils
classes.description: A utility class for persisting and restoring the state of InitializationWizardModel objects within an HTTP session context.

methods.name: saveToSession
methods.description: Saves all non-null, non-sensitive fields of InitializationWizardModel into the HTTP session using 'setup.' prefix.

methods.name: loadFromSession
methods.description: Loads session attributes with 'setup.' prefix into the corresponding fields of InitializationWizardModel.

methods.name: clearWizardSessionAttributes
methods.description: Removes all session attributes with the 'setup.' prefix from the current HTTP session.
